name: Naturalization (Standard Residence Route)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be 18 or older with full legal capacity (Article 8(1)).
Requires lawful residence for a continuous period of no less than 7 years, holding valid permanent residency at the time of application.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of continuous lawful residence, including permanent residence status.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires compliant housing and lawful income meeting minimum living standards.
No criminal convictions exceeding a 3-year sentence (with an exception for politically-motivated convictions).
Requires demonstrated knowledge of the Albanian language (spoken and written) plus basic Albanian history.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the Albanian language and history assessment.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 7 years' continuous lawful residence, including current permanent residence status
Proof of lawful income and compliant housing
Albanian language and history test results

sources.title: Republic of Albania -- Law No. 113/2020 on Citizenship (official English translation), Article 8(1): standard naturalization conditions -- 7-year continuous lawful residence with valid permanent residency, income/housing standards, no convictions over 3 years, Albanian language and history knowledge

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). Treated the GLOBALCIT-hosted English translation as tier 1: GLOBALCIT (Global Citizenship Observatory, European University Institute) publishes official government-authored translations verbatim rather than its own summary or interpretation, consistent with this dataset's convention for primary-legislation mirrors hosted on reputable non-.gov domains. dual_citizenship_allowed modeled true: the law does not prohibit holding another citizenship alongside Albanian citizenship gained by naturalization -- Article 13's renunciation provisions apply specifically to Albanians seeking to RENOUNCE Albanian citizenship (a different, opposite-direction process), not to naturalizing foreigners retaining their prior nationality. This is the general residence-based path; see al_citizenship_by_marriage.json for the faster marriage-based track and al_citizenship_by_ancestry.json for the separate ancestry-based path requiring no residence at all in some readings of Article 8(1)(dh)/(ë).
